versions.changelog:
Initial release of gtm-skill-packs, a comprehensive B2B go-to-market (GTM) skill suite for iCustomer Audience Loop.

- Covers ICP definition, account research, lead scoring (FIRE framework), prospecting, meeting preparation, outbound strategy, and inbound routing.
- Provides clear trigger phrases and direct links to skill reference files for each GTM task.
- Designed for seamless workflow across the full GTM cycle, supporting both outbound and inbound motions.
- Includes integration guidance for Audience Loop MCP tools to enhance prospecting and campaign management.
